feature_units.electronic: band gap/Fermi energy eV; DOS states/eV/reference cell
feature_units.lattice: lengths angstrom; volume/atom angstrom^3; other ratios/one-hot flags dimensionless
feature_units.bonding: formation/Ewald energy eV/atom; density g/cm^3; bulk modulus GPa; coordination counts dimensionless
feature_units.spin: DFT reference moment in Bohr magnetons/formula unit and site fractions; not measurements
feature_units.orbital: dimensionless s/p/d/f fractions within Ef +/-0.5 eV, including f in normalization
feature_units.correlation: GGA+U boolean and neutral-atom mean d-electron count, not solid-state occupations
feature_units.baseline: provider-defined Magpie units and formula shell/Lewis descriptors; inspect named features

study_metadata.pressure_scope: Pressure-agnostic Tc benchmark; missing measurement pressure is not ambient evidence
study_metadata.split: 5-fold GroupKFold by family across families and by elemental system within each family; shared MP reference IDs embargoed from training

reference_property_collection.reason: Missing properties and projections remain missing
reference_property_collection.orbital_normalization: sum of all available element/orbital projected integrals including f, not total-DOS or electron occupations
reference_property_collection.provenance: DFT-computed reference structures, not measured sample properties
reference_property_collection.dos_hash_method: SHA-256 of sorted compact Monty JSON of the CompleteDos object used for feature extraction
reference_property_collection.numeric_validation: finite property values and normalized orbital weights; missing/invalid values remain missing
reference_property_collection.reuse_note: Reference properties reused with record/MP identity validation; geometry coverage comes from the current feature table

reference_property_merge.method: Exact record_id cohort; import only reference-property columns; preserve geometry
reference_property_merge.interpretation: MP properties belong to reference calculations, not measured candidate samples

validation.interpretation: Independent versioned CI run; paired variants within this run share test indices. Compare local/CI within-family folds only after checking split identity.

local_vs_ci_fold_audit.finding: scikit-learn 1.9.1 uses stable sorting of group sizes in GroupKFold, while local 1.8.0 used the default unstable sort. An isolated CI-version environment exactly reproduced all five CI split lists and mean baselines. Cross-family folds are unchanged; within-family tie assignments differ.
